_comment: Flora grafts placed from the shell parts' graft anchors (Config/ShellAnchors/*.json, names in Art/Shells/tools/anchor_spec.py), so they fit whatever head, core, arms and legs a robot wears (Characters/WWOBodyAnchors.cpp). Used instead of the fitted model grafts where a model has anchor_grafts on (Config/CharacterModels.json) or with wwo.AnchorGrafts 1 / -WWOAnchorGrafts, and only for a flora listed here; edit and restart, no build. floras.<flora id>: a list of placements per thing equipped: 'main' (always worn: the flora's main graft), 'grenade' (any grenade) and each ability id. A 'mesh' piece with 'seat' (0-1) is laid along the surface: from its root to where the surface is that share of its length along its own -X, so a long piece lies on whatever part is worn; its pitch then lifts it. A placement puts one piece on an anchor ('anchor': its name) or one every spacing_cm along a path ('path': its name; 'range': [from, to] fractions of its length, default [0, 1]). '{s}' in a name means both sides: once with l, once with r (the r one's across offset is mirrored). Each piece is laid in the anchor's frame: out of the surface (n), across (up x n; on a front-facing anchor that is the robot's right), and its up (Head and Core: toward the robot's up; Arms and Legs: along the limb toward the body; along a path: the path's direction). offset: [out, across, up] cm from the anchor; keep it small: an anchor measures the part's surface only at its own point, and a few cm away another shell's surface can stand several cm further out or in (the scout core's codpiece buried pods placed 9 cm above hip_front, or 4 to 8 cm to its side); stay within the anchor's size, or seat it. seat: true (plates and seed pods): the offset's up and across are walked over the worn parts' surface (so a piece 8 cm to the side of the chest stays on the chest), then the piece is fitted to the surface under it (FWWOShellSurface::Seat: moved in or out and leaned with the armour, up to 25 degrees; a plate also curls to the surface across it, half to three times its curve; a pod swings toward the body by up to 30 degrees from its top), and the offset's out is the gap it leaves (0.3 sits flush; nothing is left under the surface). along: which way a plate's length runs: 'down' (against up: down the body, down a limb toward the hand or foot; the default), 'up', or 'across'. scale_by_size: the piece grows or shrinks with the anchor's size (its size / size_ref, default 5 cm, kept within 0.6 to 1.6), so a bigger part's flat spot gets a bigger piece. Pieces (FWWOGraftBuilder, all sizes cm): 'plate', a bark slab with glowing cracks: length, width, curve (the radius it bends round, small to wrap a limb; default 30), thickness (default 2), lift (its far end, toward along, raised off the body, default 0), cracked (default true); 'seed_pod', an amber pod hanging straight down from the point on a stalk: length, width, stalk (default 10, 3.5, 4). VoltVine's pieces (FWWOVineGraft, Characters/WWOVineGraft.h; in the fitted grafts' MI_VV_* materials): 'vine', a braided bark rope with a glowing core laid along a chain of paths ('paths': a list of {path, range [from, to] (from > to runs it backward), thickness (times radius), leaf_scale (a number, or [at its start, at its end]), leaves (false: none on this stretch)}, offset_cm: the path moved that far sideways over the surface, another lane beside it (toward 'toward': 'back' (default), 'front', 'up', 'down', 'outer'; a lane the same distance off a thin limb and a thick one reaches round them by different amounts), each joined to the one before across the gap between them, so a Core path runs on over a seam into an Arms or Legs path): radius cm (each strand; the rope is about 4 times that thick, its inside edge 'clear' cm off the surface), strands (3), pitch (cm per twist), core (true), taper [start, end] fractions; leaves {every cm, count [min, max] leaves there (the fitted grafts' own whole leaves, each on a green shoot), size [min, max] cm long, hang [min, max] degrees out from straight down (default 5 to 20), skip [start, end] fractions}; pods {at: fractions of the vine's length, size (0.4 is about 12 cm long), prefer: 'front' | 'outer' | 'back' | 'up' | 'down' (turned that way within a few cm)}; tendrils (how many curls along it), tendril_end; wind {radius, pitch, thorns (every cm), thorn_length}: a thinner rope weaving over it. Where a vine passes from one bone to the next, a few cm either side are posed between the two bones every frame (wwo.AnchorVineJoints 0: rigid per bone instead). 'bone_wrap': a vine's line wound round a bone instead of along paths (the hands, the same on every shell): bone, to_bone (its axis runs from the bone toward that one's joint), range, turns, phase, radii [out, across] cm, and the vine's own fields. 'crystal': a glowing crystal pod at an anchor: offset, size, lean [across, up]. 'leaf_fan': count leaves falling from an anchor, out toward the robot's side and down, fanned front to back: offset, size [min, max], down (how steeply; 1 the fitted shoulders'). A section 'grenade.<grenade id>' adds that grenade's own pieces to 'grenade'. VeilSpore's pieces (FWWOVineGraft::KitPiece and Net, in its atlas material MI_VS_Fungus): 'mesh', a static mesh from the flora's 'kit' folder (a field of the flora, beside its sections: the asset folder; Tools/import_graft_kit.py imports it from ~/Documents/WWO_Flora/kit_veilspore) named by 'mesh' (its asset name), at an anchor or along a path (every spacing_cm over 'range', or one at 'at', a fraction of the path's length). Each mesh is authored in its anchor's frame (origin on the surface, +Z out of it, +X its up) and is rigid on the anchor's (or path point's) bone, so keep the big ones off joints. Its fields: up (which way its +X points: 'anchor' (the anchor's up, the default on anchors), 'path' (the path's way, the default on paths), 'path_reverse', or 'world' (the robot's up laid into the surface; where the surface faces nearly straight up or down, the anchor's or path's own: shelf fungi want it, caps level, gills down)); offset [out, across, up] cm (up and across are walked over the worn parts' surface, so a piece can sit several cm from its anchor and stay on the part: each part's anchor file carries its surface, 'surface'; out is along the normal there); scale (default 1; times scale_by_size's factor); scale_along [first, last]: along a path, graded from the first piece to the last; zigzag_cm: along a path, each next piece walked this far to the other side of it (two staggered columns; bigger than a limb's radius puts them on its front and back); pitch and roll (degrees): roll turns it about its +Z, pitch about its +Y, + tipping +Z toward +X (a shelf's rim up, its gills out at a viewer below); jitter {roll, pitch (degrees), scale (a fraction), slide_cm (walked a random way, at most the anchor's size or half the spacing)}: each a seeded +/- amount; seed (default 1): the same loadout grows the same way on any robot; stack {count, step_cm, shrink}: count copies, each step_cm further up the surface (+X) and shrink times the size of the one before; keep_off: what no vertex may enter (or a list): a volume the worn parts carry, by name ('face', every head's: its visor, eyes or goggles and mouth, made from the head's own shape; or {volume: name, push cm}), or a capsule {from, to: anchors, radius cm, push cm}: a piece that would is walked up to 'push' cm toward its own -X (the crown: back), else left out (the log counts them). Every piece also keeps off the worn parts' obstacles (thin bits a part carries, such as the scout head's antenna and its cable, Config/ShellAnchors 'obstacles') whatever its recipe says: a kit piece is walked up to 4 cm away from one (none of its vertices inside, and the obstacle's axis through none of its triangles), else left out; a plate or pod touching one is left out; the mycelium's knots inside one are left out (the log counts all of these, and the vine points that pass through one, which are not moved yet). 'mycelium': a net of glowing strands grown over the surface (knots every 'cell' cm joined to their neighbours, holes of many sizes, a knob where three or more meet, fine roots off its edge), along a chain of paths ('paths', as a vine's, across the seams and posed between two bones where it passes a joint) 'width' cm either side ([one side, the other] or one number), or round an anchor 'size' cm across: cell (default 3.2), strand [radius in its middle, at its edge] cm (default [0.5, 0.16]), taper [start, end] (fractions of its line over which it narrows to nothing), holes (the share of knots left out), roots, clear (cm off the surface), glow (near the caps: every mesh piece but the kit's Mycelium* lights the strands within its own size), seed. Strands are grown after every mesh piece, whatever the order.

voltvine._comment: VoltVine, after the fitted SK_VV_* grafts (~/Documents/WWO_Flora/tools/make_voltvine_grafts.py). Grenade: the torso vine: from the left hip up across the back (sash_back_r, run backward), over the right shoulder, down across the chest (sash_r), then round the back of the waist on the leaning belt (belt_lean_r: high on the right) to the right hip, its leaves longer on the low (left) side; a thinner strand from the left collar to the middle of the chest (sash_l); two short branches curling round the right of the chest and waist; the grenade's own crystal bulbs on the right hip (1 Volt Grenade, 2 Shock Pool, 3 Snare Mine). Static Charge: from each collar over the shoulder seam coiling down the upper arm (collar_to_shoulder_{s} into upperarm_coil_{s}), leaves falling over the shoulder. Thornfist: coiled round the forearms (forearm_coil_{s}) with a thorny strand weaving over it. Overgrowth: from the waist over the hip seam down the whole leg (waist_to_hip_{s}, the thigh half of leg_spiral_{s}, then shin_coil_{s}), thin on the thigh, thick and leafy on the shin, a second strand down the outside of the shin. Melee Guard: a band round each hand with tiny crystals at the knuckles.

veilspore._comment: VeilSpore from kit pieces (~/Documents/WWO_Flora/tools/make_veilspore_kit.py). main (always worn), after the concept sheet: the hood: one wide thin cap down over the crown, draping past the left cheek, and from under its right and back edge a stack of smaller upright caps stepping down to the neck and onto the top of the right shoulder; and a thick lattice of mycelium over that shoulder and half the chest. Spore Fog Damage: the caps and lattice on down the right arm. Spore Dash: down the left leg. Spore Patches: patches on the body.

dawnlotus._comment: DawnLotus v2 from kit pieces (~/Documents/WWO_Flora/tools/make_dawnlotus_kit_v2.py, placements from dawnlotus_recipe_v2.py): large thin lotus petals, each seated on the worn part's surface, mirrored left and right. main (always worn): a wide open lotus on the back, petals laid like straps over the trapezius and shoulder tops and down the top of the chest. Pollination: the upper arms. Full Bloom: the thighs and shins. Petalfall: the forearms. Each grenade: a bud on the front of the right thigh with one, two or three amber drops.
